provenance.asset_description: artist Rodrigo Gallo : A friendly lashunta man with tattoos on his forearm and along the side of his head grins at the viewer while using a holographic device. He is Venture-Captain Arvin, a leader among the Starfinder Society and mentor to new Starfinder agents.
